note: Catalog of the client-facing capability ids (ADR 0032, ADR 0088). The ids form a tree: each is a dotted path under a root (`core`, or an application's own name, `memories`; ADR 0088 decision 1), and an id of three or more segments has its parent as an entry. An application's own name is an entry too, the one id of one segment: its switch, which makes the application read-only while it is off (ADR 0079 decision 8, uc.platform.switch-application-off), and an ancestor of every id under it. An entry is active only if it and every ancestor entry are active: the AND along the path, which the server computes. A client reads the leaf ids it has UI for and never ANDs them itself (ADR 0088 decisions 2 and 3). From V1 on the catalog is strictly append-only: an id, once added, is never removed, renamed or repurposed. Before V1 it was cut once, from four flat ids into this tree, because no client had been released (ADR 0088 decision 10). `serves` names the use-case(s) an entry gates, a coarser many-to-many projection, and is catalog-only metadata, never put on the wire (the manifest is [{ id }] only). `source` records how the active bit is computed: operator-policy (the Server Owner switches it off through the Admin API, PUT /api/instance/capabilities/{capabilityId}, stored in the database and applied without a restart, and the endpoint refuses with 422 capability_disabled) vs infra-preflight (a runtime probe with no off-switch; no current entry is one, ADR 0032 §5) vs external-service (an outside service the browser calls: active only while the Server Owner configured its address, PUT /api/instance/external-services/{capabilityId}, and its switches are on; both deliveries carry the address as `serviceUrl`, and the served CSP names its origin only then, ADR 0088 decision 7). `levels` names who may switch an entry off: `instance` (the Server Owner, `*` in ADR 0088's register) always, and `tenant` (a tenant owner, for their tenant, through PUT /api/tenants/{tenantId}/capability-switches/{capabilityId}, `+`) where listed. The effective state is the AND along the path at both levels, so a tenant only narrows. An entry a client offers before sign-in is instance-only, because the client cannot know a tenant's choice there (ADR 0088 decision 12). `requirements` are the entry's values that tighten it instead of switching it off (ADR 0088 decision 8): each a `flag` or a number of `days`, settable at the entry's levels, the strictest of both in effect (a flag set at either level, the smaller number of days). Each name is unique in the catalog, because it is a property of the wire's `Capability` (contracts/api/_common.openapi.yaml), and each carries its `title` and `whenSet`, what it refuses and what it does to what exists. `title`, `purpose` and `whenOff` are the entry's words for whoever switches it, each in English and German: what it is, what it is for, and what switching it off does to what is new and to what exists, as built (ADR 0088 decision 13). The catalog is the one place they are written; the backend generates its ids and these texts from it (buildSrc's GenerateCapabilityRegister), the API serves them and every client renders them from there. `description` is the dev-facing note and is not served. scripts/validate_capabilities.py checks the tree, that every `serves` resolves to a built use-case, and that every entry carries its three texts in both languages.

purpose.en: Members can share the content of an area publicly for viewing via a link.
purpose.de: Mitglieder können Inhalte eines Bereichs über einen Link öffentlich zum Ansehen teilen.

whenOff.en: No new public link can be made, and existing links stop working at once, the two kinds below included. Nothing is deleted, so the links work again once this is back on.
whenOff.de: Es lässt sich kein neuer öffentlicher Link anlegen, und bestehende Links funktionieren sofort nicht mehr, auch die beiden Arten darunter. Gelöscht wird nichts, also funktionieren die Links wieder, sobald dieser Eintrag wieder an ist.

whenSet.en: Every link needs a password; existing links without one stop working until they get one.
whenSet.de: Jeder Link braucht ein Passwort; bestehende Links ohne Passwort funktionieren nicht mehr, bis sie eines bekommen.

title.en: Links expire after this many days
title.de: Links laufen nach so vielen Tagen ab

whenSet.en: Every link expires after this many days at the latest; existing links without an end date, or with a later one, stop working until they get one that fits. An expired link can be renewed.
whenSet.de: Jeder Link läuft spätestens nach so vielen Tagen ab; bestehende Links ohne Enddatum oder mit einem späteren funktionieren nicht mehr, bis sie ein passendes bekommen. Ein abgelaufener Link lässt sich erneuern.

core.public-shares.description: Public share links of a node in the READ access mode, and the parent of every other share entry. Off => createShare, reactivateShare and reissueShare of a READ link are refused with 422 capability_disabled, and by the AND along the path so are those of a contribute and a drop-box link; the client hides the Share affordance. A share switch acts at once (ADR 0088 decision 5): every guest endpoint answers an existing link of a switched-off role exactly as an unknown link (404 share_not_found, ShareGuestGate.activeShare), and serves it again when the entry is back on, because nothing is written onto the link.

purpose.en: A public link whose guests can add to what they see, not only look at it. What a guest can add is up to the application the link leads into.
purpose.de: Ein öffentlicher Link, über den Gäste nicht nur ansehen, sondern auch etwas hinzufügen können. Was ein Gast hinzufügen kann, bestimmt die Anwendung, in die der Link führt.

whenOff.en: No new link of this kind can be made, and existing ones stop working at once. What guests added stays, and the links work again once this is back on.
whenOff.de: Es lässt sich kein neuer Link dieser Art anlegen, und bestehende funktionieren sofort nicht mehr. Was Gäste hinzugefügt haben, bleibt, und die Links funktionieren wieder, sobald dieser Eintrag wieder an ist.

core.public-shares.contribute.description: Public share links in the READ_WRITE access mode: the guest reads and also adds; what the write adds is the application's. Off => createShare, reactivateShare and reissueShare of a READ_WRITE link, and updateShare changing a READ link into one, are refused with 422 capability_disabled, and the client does not offer the role. Every guest endpoint answers an existing READ_WRITE link exactly as an unknown link (404 share_not_found) until the entry is back on (ADR 0088 decision 5).

purpose.en: A public link through which guests can add, but cannot see what is already there or what others added.
purpose.de: Ein öffentlicher Link, über den Gäste etwas einwerfen können, ohne zu sehen, was schon da ist oder was andere eingeworfen haben.

whenOff.en: No new link of this kind can be made, and existing ones stop working at once. Drop boxes keep what is in them, and the links work again once this is back on.
whenOff.de: Es lässt sich kein neuer Link dieser Art anlegen, und bestehende funktionieren sofort nicht mehr. Briefkästen behalten, was darin liegt, und die Links funktionieren wieder, sobald dieser Eintrag wieder an ist.

core.public-shares.drop-box.description: Public share links in the WRITE_ONLY access mode (a drop box: a guest adds and cannot read what others added; what it adds is the application's). Off => createShare, reactivateShare and reissueShare of a WRITE_ONLY link are refused with 422 capability_disabled, and so is creating a drop-box node (Depot's DEPOT_DROPBOX, createNode); the client hides the write-only option and the drop box. Every guest endpoint answers an existing WRITE_ONLY link exactly as an unknown link (404 share_not_found) until the entry is back on (ADR 0088 decision 5); an existing drop box node stays, since creating one is a feature switch that refuses only what is new.

purpose.en: Members can create groups: spaces that several members use together, beside each member's own personal space.
purpose.de: Mitglieder können Gruppen anlegen: Bereiche, die mehrere Mitglieder gemeinsam nutzen, neben dem persönlichen Bereich jedes Mitglieds.

whenOff.en: No new group can be created, so only personal spaces are offered. Groups that already exist stay and work as before.
whenOff.de: Es lässt sich keine neue Gruppe mehr anlegen; angeboten werden dann nur persönliche Bereiche. Bestehende Gruppen bleiben und funktionieren wie bisher.

title.en: Being added to a group needs a yes
title.de: Aufnahme in eine Gruppe braucht ein Ja

whenSet.en: Whoever is added to a group is asked first and joins only once they say yes, whatever their own setting says. Members already in a group stay.
whenSet.de: Wer in eine Gruppe aufgenommen wird, wird zuerst gefragt und kommt erst nach einem Ja dazu, egal was die eigene Einstellung sagt. Wer schon in einer Gruppe ist, bleibt.

core.group-space.description: Shared group spaces. Off => creating a group scope (createGroup) is refused with 422 capability_disabled and the client hides the affordance: a personal-only instance. A feature switch refuses only what is new (ADR 0088 decision 5), so an existing group stays usable: renaming it, managing its members, deleting and restoring it, and accepting or declining an add keep working.

purpose.en: A device a member has signed in on can keep a key of its own, so that it unlocks next time with the password alone, without the Secret Key from the Emergency Kit.
purpose.de: Ein Gerät, auf dem sich ein Mitglied angemeldet hat, kann einen eigenen Schlüssel behalten und entsperrt dann beim nächsten Mal allein mit dem Passwort, ohne den Secret Key aus dem Notfall-Kit.

whenOff.en: No device can be newly remembered, and devices remembered before stop unlocking that way at once; unlocking without a password is off too. Members then need their password and their Secret Key from the Emergency Kit. Nothing is deleted, so switching back on restores every remembered device.
whenOff.de: Kein Gerät lässt sich neu merken, und bereits gemerkte Geräte entsperren sofort nicht mehr auf diesem Weg; das Entsperren ohne Passwort ist ebenfalls aus. Mitglieder brauchen dann ihr Passwort und ihren Secret Key aus dem Notfall-Kit. Gelöscht wird nichts, also entsperrt jedes gemerkte Gerät wieder wie zuvor, sobald der Eintrag wieder an ist.

title.en: Ask for the password again after this many days
title.de: Nach so vielen Tagen erneut nach dem Passwort fragen

whenSet.en: Every signed-in device, remembered ones too, asks for the password again once this many days have passed since it signed in or was added. Devices already past that are asked within a quarter of an hour.
whenSet.de: Jedes angemeldete Gerät, auch ein gemerktes, fragt erneut nach dem Passwort, sobald seit der Anmeldung oder dem Hinzufügen so viele Tage vergangen sind. Geräte, bei denen das schon so ist, werden innerhalb einer Viertelstunde gefragt.

core.remember-device.description: Remembering a device: a DEVICE wrap, the Master Key under the password and a device-bound key that stands in for the Secret Key. Off => enrolling a DEVICE wrap (addAccountWrap) is refused with 422 capability_disabled, and by the AND along the path so is a passwordless one; the client hides "remember this device". Unlocking with a wrap that already exists, and deleting one, stay allowed.

purpose.en: A remembered device can open straight in, with neither the password nor the Secret Key, because it holds a key that is enough on its own.
purpose.de: Ein gemerktes Gerät kann direkt öffnen, ganz ohne Passwort und Secret Key, weil es einen Schlüssel hält, der allein genügt.

whenOff.en: No device can be newly set up to unlock without a password, and a device added from another one keeps no key. Devices set up this way stop opening straight in at once; members then need their password and their Secret Key from the Emergency Kit. Nothing is deleted, so switching back on restores them. This entry is also off whenever Remembered devices is off.
whenOff.de: Kein Gerät lässt sich neu so einrichten, dass es ohne Passwort entsperrt, und ein Gerät, das über ein anderes hinzugefügt wird, behält keinen Schlüssel. So eingerichtete Geräte öffnen sofort nicht mehr direkt; Mitglieder brauchen dann ihr Passwort und ihren Secret Key aus dem Notfall-Kit. Gelöscht wird nichts, also öffnen diese Geräte wieder direkt, sobald der Eintrag wieder an ist. Dieser Eintrag ist außerdem immer dann aus, wenn „Gemerkte Geräte“ aus ist.

core.remember-device.passwordless.description: Passwordless unlock on a remembered device: a DEVICE_KEY wrap, the Master Key under a device key alone. Off => enrolling a DEVICE_KEY wrap (addAccountWrap) is refused with 422 capability_disabled; the client hides the passwordless choice, and a linked device gets a session but no stored key (ADR 0088 decision 11).

title.en: Add a device from another one

purpose.en: A member signs in on a new device by pairing it through a QR code with a device that is already unlocked, without typing the password and the Secret Key on the new one.
purpose.de: Ein Mitglied meldet sich auf einem neuen Gerät an, indem es dieses per QR-Code mit einem bereits entsperrten Gerät koppelt – ohne auf dem neuen Gerät Passwort und Secret Key einzugeben.

whenOff.en: No device can be added this way any more, and an addition already under way stops. Devices added before are not affected. Members sign in on a new device with their password and their Secret Key.
whenOff.de: Auf diesem Weg lässt sich kein Gerät mehr hinzufügen, und ein Hinzufügen, das gerade läuft, bricht ab. Bereits hinzugefügte Geräte sind nicht betroffen. Auf einem neuen Gerät melden sich Mitglieder dann mit Passwort und Secret Key an.

core.device-linking.description: Linking a device from one that is already unlocked (ADR 0059): the Master Key reaches the new device from the other one instead of from the password and the Secret Key. Off => every /api/pairing/* endpoint (open, answer, delegate, seal, collect) is refused with 422 capability_disabled, which also stops a pairing in flight; the client hides "sign in with code" and the add-device entry. Independent of core.remember-device (ADR 0088 decision 11).

purpose.en: When someone chooses a password, the browser asks a breached-password service whether it appears in a known leak, and warns them if it does. The service’s address is a setting of this instance.
purpose.de: Wählt jemand ein Passwort, fragt der Browser einen Dienst für geleakte Passwörter, ob es in einem bekannten Leck vorkommt, und warnt, wenn ja. Die Adresse des Dienstes ist eine Einstellung dieser Instanz.

whenOff.en: Nobody’s new password is checked against known leaks any more, and the browser is no longer allowed to reach the service at all. Passwords already chosen are not affected. The same holds while no address is set.
whenOff.de: Neue Passwörter werden nicht mehr gegen bekannte Lecks geprüft, und der Browser darf den Dienst gar nicht mehr erreichen. Bereits gewählte Passwörter sind nicht betroffen. Dasselbe gilt, solange keine Adresse gesetzt ist.

core.breached-password.description: The k-anonymity range check of a chosen password (security-model.md § the breached-password check): the browser fetches <serviceUrl><first five hex of SHA-1> and compares the suffixes locally. Instance-only, because the join and recover screens run it before sign-in. Active only while a URL is configured (veyq_external_service) and the entry is on; the served CSP names its origin in connect-src only then.

purpose.en: Members keep photos and videos in Memories, with chapters, and share them. Place names and maps belong to it.
purpose.de: Mitglieder bewahren Fotos und Videos in Erinnerungen auf, mit Kapiteln, und teilen sie. Ortsnamen und Karten gehören dazu.

whenOff.en: Nothing new can be added to Memories or changed in them. Everything there can still be opened and downloaded until the day shown at the top of veyq; then it is erased, unless Memories is switched on again before.
whenOff.de: In Erinnerungen kann nichts Neues dazukommen und nichts geändert werden. Alles darin lässt sich bis zu dem Tag öffnen und herunterladen, den veyq oben anzeigt; dann wird es gelöscht, wenn Erinnerungen nicht vorher wieder eingeschaltet wird.

memories.description: The Memories application (ADR 0079 decision 8). Off => it is read-only in the tenant (uc.platform.switch-application-off, ADR 0088 decision 5): every write of it is refused with 422 capability_disabled — a MEMORY or CHAPTER node created, updated, given a cover or a banner, an upload started or completed for one, a link rooted on one created, reactivated, re-issued or given a write role, every guest write into one, and every non-GET operation of contracts/api/memories/ but the named exemptions (deleteMedia, restoreMedia, deleteShareMedia, deleteBucket, purgeMedia, putItemFavorites, stageMediaRekey). Reads, downloads, a delete to the trash and its restore, the re-key, erasures and moderation measures stay. memories.places and memories.map are off with it (the AND along the path). Left off for veyq.application.off.retention (default P30D) from the moment it went off for the tenant, at either level, every MEMORY and CHAPTER made before that day is erased in every scope of the tenant, with everything that hangs off it, through the trash purge's erase (uc.platform.erase-switched-off-application); switched on before the day, nothing is erased. Core folders stay.

purpose.en: A Memory’s place is named from its coordinates by a geocoding service the browser asks directly, so the name appears without typing. The service’s address is a setting of this instance.
purpose.de: Der Ort einer Erinnerung bekommt seinen Namen aus den Koordinaten von einem Geocoding-Dienst, den der Browser direkt fragt, sodass der Name ohne Tippen erscheint. Die Adresse des Dienstes ist eine Einstellung dieser Instanz.

whenOff.en: No place is named by the service any more: members type a place’s name, and the browser is no longer allowed to reach the service. Places already named keep their names. The same holds while no address is set.
whenOff.de: Kein Ort wird mehr vom Dienst benannt: Mitglieder tippen den Namen eines Orts selbst, und der Browser darf den Dienst nicht mehr erreichen. Bereits benannte Orte behalten ihre Namen. Dasselbe gilt, solange keine Adresse gesetzt ist.

memories.places.description: The reverse geocoder (ADR 0016): Nominatim-compatible /reverse, fetched by the browser. Active only while a URL is configured and the entry is on at both levels; the served CSP names its origin in connect-src while it is on at the instance level. Independent of memories.map (ADR 0088 § The register).

purpose.en: Memories and spaces show a map of their places, drawn from map tiles the browser loads from a tile service. The service’s address and its attribution are settings of this instance.
purpose.de: Erinnerungen und Bereiche zeigen eine Karte ihrer Orte, gezeichnet aus Kartenkacheln, die der Browser von einem Kacheldienst lädt. Adresse und Namensnennung des Dienstes sind Einstellungen dieser Instanz.

whenOff.en: No map is shown any more and no pin can be dropped on one; places stay, with their names, and can still be named by hand. The browser is no longer allowed to load tiles. The same holds while no address is set.
whenOff.de: Es wird keine Karte mehr gezeigt, und auf keiner lässt sich eine Nadel setzen; Orte bleiben mit ihren Namen und lassen sich weiter von Hand benennen. Der Browser darf keine Kacheln mehr laden. Dasselbe gilt, solange keine Adresse gesetzt ist.

memories.map.description: The map tiles (ADR 0018): a {z}/{x}/{y} URL template loaded as images. Active only while a URL is configured and the entry is on at both levels; the served CSP names its origin in img-src while it is on at the instance level. Independent of memories.places.

purpose.en: Members keep documents and any other file in their spaces, and collect files from others in drop boxes.
purpose.de: Mitglieder bewahren Dokumente und jede andere Datei in ihren Bereichen auf und sammeln in Briefkästen Dateien von anderen.

whenOff.en: No files can be added or changed. Everything there can still be opened and downloaded until the day shown at the top of veyq; then it is erased, unless Depot is switched on again before.
whenOff.de: Dateien können weder dazukommen noch geändert werden. Alles lässt sich bis zu dem Tag öffnen und herunterladen, den veyq oben anzeigt; dann wird es gelöscht, wenn Depot nicht vorher wieder eingeschaltet wird.

depot.description: The Depot application (ADR 0079 decision 8). Off => it is read-only in the tenant (uc.platform.switch-application-off, ADR 0088 decision 5): every write of it is refused with 422 capability_disabled — a FILE or DEPOT_DROPBOX node created, updated, given a cover, an upload started or completed for one, a link rooted on one created, reactivated, re-issued or given a write role, every guest write into one (a drop box's included), and every non-GET operation of contracts/api/depot/. Reads, downloads, a delete to the trash and its restore, the re-key, erasures and moderation measures stay. The drop box's own creation switch stays core.public-shares.drop-box. Left off for veyq.application.off.retention (default P30D) from the moment it went off for the tenant, at either level, every FILE and DEPOT_DROPBOX made before that day is erased in every scope of the tenant, with everything that hangs off it, a drop box's guest folders included, through the trash purge's erase (uc.platform.erase-switched-off-application); switched on before the day, nothing is erased. Core folders stay.

purpose.en: Members and their link guests record shared expenses in Pots and see who owes whom.
purpose.de: Mitglieder und ihre Link-Gäste erfassen gemeinsame Ausgaben in Kassen und sehen, wer wem etwas schuldet.

whenOff.en: No Pot can be created and no entry added or changed. Every Pot can still be opened and downloaded until the day shown at the top of veyq; then it is erased, unless Expenses is switched on again before.
whenOff.de: Keine Kasse kann angelegt und kein Eintrag hinzugefügt oder geändert werden. Jede Kasse lässt sich bis zu dem Tag öffnen und herunterladen, den veyq oben anzeigt; dann wird sie gelöscht, wenn Ausgaben nicht vorher wieder eingeschaltet wird.

expenses.description: The Expenses application (ADR 0079 decision 8, ADR 0108). Off => it is read-only in the tenant (uc.platform.switch-application-off, ADR 0088 decision 5): every write of it is refused with 422 capability_disabled — an EXPENSES_POT node created, updated, given a link or a write role, a member's or a guest's append of revisions (contracts/api/expenses/). Reads, downloads, a delete to the trash and its restore, the re-key, a participant's erasure and moderation measures stay. Left off for veyq.application.off.retention (default P30D) from the moment it went off for the tenant, at either level, every EXPENSES_POT made before that day is erased in every scope of the tenant, with its revisions and receipts, through the trash purge's erase (uc.platform.erase-switched-off-application); switched on before the day, nothing is erased. Core folders stay.

purpose.en: Where an entry’s currency differs from its Pot’s, the browser fetches the day’s exchange rates from a rate service once a day and fills in the rate. The service’s address is a setting of this instance.
purpose.de: Weicht die Währung eines Eintrags von der seiner Kasse ab, lädt der Browser einmal am Tag die Wechselkurse des Tages von einem Kursdienst und trägt den Kurs ein. Die Adresse des Dienstes ist eine Einstellung dieser Instanz.

whenOff.en: No rate is filled in any more: whoever writes an entry in another currency types its rate, and the browser is no longer allowed to reach the service. Entries already saved keep their rates. The same holds while no address is set.
whenOff.de: Kein Kurs wird mehr eingetragen: Wer einen Eintrag in einer anderen Währung schreibt, tippt den Kurs selbst, und der Browser darf den Dienst nicht mehr erreichen. Bereits gespeicherte Einträge behalten ihre Kurse. Dasselbe gilt, solange keine Adresse gesetzt ist.

expenses.exchange-rates.description: The day's exchange-rate table (ADR 0108 decision 8): a URL template holding {date} (the device's date, YYYY-MM-DD) that answers with the whole day's table of the European Central Bank's euro reference rates in Frankfurter's v2 shape (an array of {date, base, quote, rate}, base EUR; a new instance's is Frankfurter's ECB endpoint, owner 2026-10-25), fetched by the browser straight from the provider at most once per device and day for every Pot, never with a currency, an amount or a veyq identity. Active only while a URL is configured and the entry is on at both levels, under the Expenses switch — a member's client reads it from its tenant's set, a link guest's from its Pot read (exchangeRateService, contracts/api/expenses/), never from the instance's manifest; the served CSP names its origin in connect-src while it is on at the instance level. The privacy notice gives it a passage of its own (exchange-rates), beside the breached-password check's.
